open_risks.text: Unclassified settings keys land once then freeze — sandbox, defaultMode and permissions.ask ship on the promotion that first introduces them, after which live wins permanently and every repo-side revision is silently inert

permissions.allow only ever grows through promotion — the sole retraction channel is a frozen hardcoded array in the unversioned manifest.mjs, so no PR can remove an allow grant and the existing Bash(node:*) drift is permanent
validate.mjs is a syntax gate only — it never executes hook logic, so a behaviorally wrong permission gate passes validation and promotes to live unnoticed; only runtime testing catches it
promote.mjs's CLI accepts an arbitrary ref with no main-only restriction — that guard lives only in converge.mjs, so a manual promote could put a half-built feature branch live
Local main is 10 behind origin/main and nothing fetches — a merged PR reaches live only after a human advances local refs/heads/main, and that advance would also drag in 10 unrelated commits

protect-claude-config.sh discovers the repo's .claude via the LIVE receipt repo_root, symlink probes and git worktree list — narrowing it to live-only must remove that discovery, not just edit the path list

key_decisions.title: D2 guards the live installed copy, not version-controlled source
